test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa884f4253ecded837789fe4ee2eb1ecc48ddd4816f2e1a8f02299e77d2473a2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The Symbol 'Square' has shifted one place in next images, and getting started again after reaching the last corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/824ca1ede1852bbf2856cdd5066302ad190f67a1ac58a53cd1c16cd3254b110f.png] 

Step II: The Symbol 'Triangle' are getting rotated in 90 degree in clockwise direction, and shifted one place in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/116a56ebb3ef74c7d44f30a7ac7fa64ca50a74209df94b69bc30315fae7339d6.png] 

Step III: The Symbol 'Diamond' has shifted one place in next images, and getting started again after reaching the last corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a53cda348162abf355904beef3db5eec00060720fe1a7aef66db18bb2f113111.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5415d2f2c34d6e7d37bf938c61c61ddb94bc3f29c774ef773953072f659b893e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
